correctness.rationale: From the source's GL density and survival, each factor has α²/(1+α). Every observed competing-risk failure has a density times the other cause survival, and each withdrawn unit supplies both survivals, so the MODEL likelihood has normalizer α^(4(m+R))/(1+α)^(2(m+R)). Counting source Eq. (3.1)'s factors gives α^(4m)/(1+α)^(4m+2R). Therefore L_3.1/L_model=α^(-4R)(1+α)^(-2m), parameter dependent. Expanded source Eq. (3.2) instead retains model-correct normalizers. Its Bayesian Eq. (4.2) explicitly uses the misfactored product, so the correct posterior kernel is π_4.2 * α^(4R)(1+α)^(2m), with log score difference 4R/α+2m/(1+α). The independent exact-rational normalization check verifies the identity for multiple m,R,α. No inference is made about inaccessible simulation software or classical likelihood results based on Eq. (3.2).
